lastCompletedStory.title: Scaffold de webui/ com vite + Tailwind v4 CSS-first, split de typecheck e entrada no knip

nextStoryContext: The browser client now lives under webui/ with no nested package.json. Use bun run build:ui for the Vite/Tailwind build; bun run typecheck checks the root non-DOM program first and webui/tsconfig.app.json second. webui/dist is generated and ignored, not embedded through templates or src/vendor/_generated.ts. Knip treats webui/src/main.tsx and webui/vite.config.ts as entries and scans the rest of webui for orphan files.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Official Vite integration confirms tailwindcss(), the @tailwindcss/vite plugin, and the CSS-first @import "tailwindcss" entry used by the scaffold.
Official guide confirms index.html as the module-graph entry and supports passing webui as the alternate Vite root.
Official React reference confirms importing createRoot from react-dom/client and rendering JSX into a browser DOM element.
